text:
alex: Heads-up — hit a duplicate resource when our Python client retried a POST after a 502. No Idempotency-Key, so server created twice.
priya: Oof. Which SDK/version and sync/async?
alex: py-sdk 0.9.1, sync. We hit a transient 502 during request body upload, client retry logic re-sent same body and got 201 on retry. Minimal repro attached.
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# short timeout to force the behavior
resp = c.post('/v1/items', json={'name': 'widget'})
```
priya: Any logs? curious if it's transport-level replay or retry middleware.
alex: logs show: "POST /v1/items -> 502, retrying (attempt 2) -> 201 Created". No Idempotency-Key header emitted.
tom: Historically we left idempotency to users. But defaulting an Idempotency-Key on retry seems like low-risk hardening. Need to think about customers relying on non-idempotent semantics.
laura: Agree with caution. Proposal: SDK should not silently change request semantics. Options: (A) opt-in client flag idempotency.auto_on_retry=true; (B) warn at runtime when POST+retries+no id key; (C) limit auto-generation to small buffered bodies (<512KB) only.
priya: Also we need to handle async difference: AsyncClient streams bodies differently and earlier bug re-used coroutine iterators causing dead replays. We must align behavior between sync and async.
alex: For immediate mitigation, can we lower default retry attempts for POSTs and make idempotency auto-on for new client instances?
tom: Lowering retries is safer. We can also add a prominent note in the onboarding quickstart about "POSTs may be retried; provide Idempotency-Key".
laura: I'll take the async body replay bug. Plan: buffer body for replay if content-length <= 512KB; else mark non-replayable and fail fast with a helpful error advising to provide Idempotency-Key or disable retries. Add tests for chunked generator bodies.
priya: For backoff, the retry policy should use decorrelated jitter (per standard) and not blindly immediate retry on 5xx. Also differentiate between 5xx and 502/504 vs 429/client-side timeouts.
alex: Good call. Also customers expect retries on idempotent methods only; maybe we should treat POST as non-idempotent by default but allow auto-key generation on retry.
tom: Implementation sketch: add IdempotencyMiddleware that intercepts outgoing requests; if method is POST and retries enabled and no existing idempotency header, then if body bufferable and config.auto_idempotency=true generate UUID v4 and add header. If not bufferable, skip and warn.
laura: I'll add unit tests: sync vs async, generator body, file-stream, small JSON, header provided, header present but blank, and ensure middleware respects per-request overrides.
priya: Docs: expand "retries & idempotency" in SDK reference and include code snippet how to set idempotency key and disable retries for specific calls. Also add migration note for customers upgrading from <0.9.x.
devex-bot: Created ticket DE-4812: "py-sdk: POST replay causing duplicate resource; add idempotency middleware and async replay fix" assigned to laura, tom.
alex: Thanks. I'll follow up with the customer and share repro logs. If anyone has objections to auto-idempotency default change, speak up now.
tom: No objections to opt-in flag. For default behavior we'll ship warning first, then consider opt-in in next minor.
laura: I'll send a PR for async fix + tests, and a separate RFC for the middleware.
priya: I'll draft docs blurb and an onboarding note for quickstart.
alex: Great, thanks all.
